name: Stereo Rectification
summary: Generate horizontal stereo rectification maps and Q from K1/D1/K2/D2/R/T calibration. Connect maps to Remap; this element does not process images itself.

calibrationFile.label: Calibration JSON (if input is not connected)
calibrationFile.description: Connected calibration takes precedence. Supports the documented schema for known synthetic geometry.

alpha.label: Field of view alpha
alpha.description: -1: OpenCV default; 0: crop to valid pixels; 1: retain all source pixels. Output keeps the calibrated resolution.
